inv.desc_en:
OPPORTUNITY IN ARGÜELLES!

Commercial Premises of 233 m² with Smoke Outlet on Calle Quintana

Premium Location: Calle Quintana 30, in the heart of the Argüelles neighborhood, Madrid.

A fully consolidated residential, commercial, and university area, with constant and diverse pedestrian traffic and exceptional transport connections (Argüelles Metro L3, L4, L6, and Moncloa).

Main Features:

• Total Area: 233.67 m² distributed over two floors.
• Ground Floor: 171.45 m²
• Basement: 62.22 m²
• Large Facade: 7 meters with a large glass storefront
• Smoke Outlet
• Condition: Fitted out and ready to be adapted to your business needs. Delivered completely empty and free of tenants.
• Permitted Use: restaurant, retail, or services
• Scope of the offer: Furniture, machinery, and decorative elements not included unless otherwise agreed in writing.
